build.title: axHub runs approved calls itself: hold the call, run on Approve, drop on Reject; sessions send once and never wait

said.text: send the command to axHub; axHub waits for approval and runs it or not; the session does not wait. Today a confirm call returns confirmation_required and drops the call, so the session must re-send it with the confirmation_id after approval, which is why sessions poll (each check re-reads the whole chat). Change: axHub stores the full call on create; Approve = the hub runs it itself and keeps the result; Reject/expire = dropped. The session gets an approval id at once and moves on; it reads the result once later only if needed. Replaces the polling rule (15 s x10 then 1 min). HELD: queued in Refactor; Brett says go.

steps.text: axHub: confirm calls are stored whole (tool, args, reason, caller) when created; Approve runs them in the hub as a job and keeps the result; Reject/expire drops them; old re-send-with-confirmation_id path keeps working
axHub: result lookup by approval id (pending/ran/failed/rejected/expired + output); MCP call returns {approval_id, state: pending} at once; AmberX push unchanged
Shared rule: send once, never poll; read the result once only when needed (replaces the 15 s / 1 min retry rule); THREADS; tests; PR (axHub) + merge approval
